# Panwar Health Care — Dr. Satta Ram Panwar

> Panwar Health Care is the clinic of Dr. Satta Ram Panwar, a General, Laparoscopic and Trauma Specialist Surgeon (Gastro Surgeon) in Jaisalmer, Rajasthan, India. The clinic runs a live online queue and appointment system: patients can book an appointment online, take a walk-in token, and watch the live OPD queue before visiting.

## About the doctor
- Name: Dr. Satta Ram Panwar (Dr. S. R. Panwar)
- Specialty: General Surgery, Laparoscopic Surgery, Trauma Surgery, Gastro Surgery
- Clinic: Panwar Health Care, Behind Poonam Stadium, Jaisalmer, Rajasthan, India
- Phone: +91 96362 43621
- OPD hours: Monday to Saturday 1:00 PM – 7:30 PM; Sunday 11:00 AM – 4:00 PM

## Services
- Laparoscopic (keyhole / doorbeen) surgery — दूरबीन सर्जरी
- Hernia surgery — हर्निया का ऑपरेशन
- Gallbladder stone surgery (laparoscopic cholecystectomy) — पित्ते की पथरी का ऑपरेशन
- Appendix surgery (appendectomy) — अपेंडिक्स का ऑपरेशन
- Trauma and emergency surgery — चोट व इमरजेंसी सर्जरी
- Gastro / abdominal surgery — पेट व पाचन संबंधी सर्जरी
